title: ETSI TS 103 705 Types schema
description: JSON schema for ETSI-defined types (see clause 6.1 and Annex A)

CSPServiceRecord.title: CSP Service Record
CSPServiceRecord.description: Information about some new fictional service that this CSP provides

timeOfService.description: Time at which something happened (using an ETSI TS 103 280 type)

dataVolumeUsed.description: A data volume associated with this service record (using an ETSI TS 103 705 type)

numberOfService.description: Some number associated with this service record (using a native JSON type)

serviceEnum.description: A field using a type defined elsewhere in this schema
